title: MARCUS: An agentic, multimodal vision-language model for cardiac diagnosis and management
abstract: arXiv:2603.22179v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of global mortality, with progress hindered by human interpretation of complex cardiac tests. Current AI vision-language models are limited to single-modality inputs and are non-interactive. We present MARCUS (Multimodal Autonomous Reasoning and Chat for Ultrasound and Signals), an agentic vision-language system for end-to-end interpretation of electrocardiograms (ECGs), echocardiograms, and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) independently and as multimodal input. MARCUS employs a hierarchical agentic architecture comprising modality-specific vision-language expert models, each integrating domain-trained visual encoders with multi-stage language model optimization, coordinated by a multimodal orchestrator. translated_title: MARCUS：一个用于心脏诊断与管理的智能体化多模态视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: 心血管疾病仍然是全球死亡的首要原因，其进展受到人类对复杂心脏检查解读能力的制约。目前的AI视觉-语言模型仅限于单模态输入且不具备交互性。我们提出了MARCUS（多模态自主推理与超声及信号对话系统），这是一个智能体化的视觉-语言系统，能够独立地或以多模态输入的方式对心电图（ECG）、超声心动图和心脏磁共振成像（CMR）进行端到端解读。MARCUS采用分层智能体架构，包含针对特定模态的视觉-语言专家模型，每个模型集成了领域训练的视觉编码器与多阶段语言模型优化，并由多模态协调器进行统筹协调。MARCUS在1350万张图像（25万份心电图、130万张超声心动图图像、1200万张心脏磁共振图像）以及我们新构建的由专家整理、涵盖160万个问题的数据集上进行了训练……
tldr: MARCUS是一个智能体化多模态视觉-语言模型，通过分层专家架构协同解读心电图、超声心动图和心脏磁共振成像，实现自主交互式的心脏诊断与管理。
en_tdlr: MARCUS is an agentic multimodal vision-language model with a hierarchical expert architecture that collaboratively interprets ECGs, echocardiograms, and cardiac MRI for autonomous and interactive cardiac diagnosis and management.
